other_conditions: Applicant must possess a valid ration card under NFSA or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme
All family members listed on the ration card must have Aadhaar numbers linked and verified
Applicant’s Aadhaar must be linked to a valid bank account and an updated mobile number
Applicant’s two-wheeler must be registered in their name and in the state of Jharkhand
Applicant must possess a valid driving license
benefits_summary: ₹25 per litre subsidy for up to 10 litres of petrol per month, transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account.
